abstract: Xenograft acceptance, growth and spontaneous metastasis of ectopically transplanted human germinal tumors were compared among scid mice, athymic nude mice and F2 hybrids constructed from scid and nude mice, in relation to the impairments of T and B cell functions in these mice. In scid mice which are deficient in T and B cell functions, human yolk sac tumor (YST-2) that originated from the ovary grew to enormous sizes in 100% of the animals after both subcutaneous and intraperitoneal transplantation, while only half (59.1% and 51.9%) of the subcutaneous and none of the intraperitoneal transplants were accepted in usual athymic nude mice (BALB/c-nu/nu and CD1-nu/nu). The YST-2 grew rapidly in scid mice, developing 3 to 10 times larger tumors compared to nude-streaker (AKR/J-nustr/nustr) and usual nude mice, respectively. Furthermore, ectopically transplanted tumors spontaneously metastasized to distant organs (mostly to the lung) in scid mice (but less frequently in leaky scid mice), while metastases have never been found in nude mice. Although a xenograft of human classic (typical or pure) seminoma of the testis has never been established in nude mice, it grows slowly in one-third (36.4%) of scid mice and very rapidly in all of scid-nustr (scid/scid; nustr/nustr) double mutant mice. Spontaneous metastases of xenografted seminomas were also observed in distant organs (lymph node, lung, liver, spleen, and kidney). The metastastic distribution of the two human germinal tumors in scid and scid-nustr mice mimics that found in human. These results (xenograft acceptance, growth of transplanted tumors and degree of metastatic spread) were compatible with the level of T and B cell impairments indicated by FACS analysis, as well as mitogen responses, serum IgG and morphological features of the thymus.
abstract_ja: scidマウス、ヌードマウス、およびscidとヌードマウスから作製したF2雑種マウスを用い、ヒト胚細胞腫瘍を異所移植した際の異種移植の生着、増殖、自然転移を比較した。scidマウスはT細胞およびB細胞機能が欠損しているが、卵巣由来のヒト卵黄嚢腫瘍(YST-2)を皮下および腹腔内に移植すると、全例で巨大に増殖した。一方、通常のヌードマウス(BALB/c-nu/nuおよびCD1-nu/nu)では、皮下移植の51.9~59.1%のみが生着し、腹腔内移植では全く生着しなかった。YST-2はscidマウスでヌードマウスの3~10倍の大きさに増殖した。異所移植した腫瘍は、scidマウス(特にリーキーscidマウス)で遠隔臓器(主に肺)へ自然転移したが、ヌードマウスでは転移は認められなかった。ヒトの古典的(典型的または純粋な)精巣セミノーマの異種移植は、ヌードマウスでは確立されたことがないが、scidマウスの3分の1(36.4%)ではゆっくり増殖し、scid-nustr(scid/scid; nustr/nustr)二重変異マウスではすべてで急速に増殖した。異種移植したセミノーマでも、リンパ節、肺、肝臓、脾臓、腎臓などの遠隔臓器に自然転移が観察された。scidおよびscid-nustrマウスにおける2種類のヒト胚細胞腫瘍の転移分布は、ヒトで見られるものを模倣していた。異種移植の生着、移植腫瘍の増殖、転移の拡がりの程度は、FACS解析、マイトジェン応答、血清IgG、胸腺の形態学的特徴で示されたT細胞およびB細胞障害の程度と一致していた。
